annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部 农业农村部关于印发《“商渔共治2023”专项行动实施方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Transport and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the "Merchant-Fishing Vessel Co-governance 2023" Special Action
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部; 农业农村部 (Ministry of Transport; Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Transport and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs notice issuing the 2023 special action plan to reduce collisions between merchant and fishing vessels through joint patrols, education campaigns, AIS enforcement and accident investigation cooperation. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Joint patrol enforcement in key waters, checking VHF16 watch and AIS use
Cleanup of improperly deployed net-position AIS devices on fishing gear
Joint safety education for merchant and fishing vessel captains
Safety reminders for foreign-flag vessels entering Chinese coastal waters
Multi-agency accident investigation and reporting deadlines through October 2023
